nodes.label: Beautiful Picture - Mountain Wilderness Camp at Dusk
nodes.description: Dramatic landscape photograph of snow-capped mountain peaks partially obscured by clouds at dusk or dawn. In the foreground, a small encampment of several vehicles with warm artificial lights glowing, set on a vast dark rocky plateau. A glacier or snowfield is visible between the mountains in the background. The mood is remote, adventurous, and atmospheric. Likely Central Asia (e.g. Pamir, Tian Shan, or Karakoram region) based on terrain.
nodes.color_palette: cool blues and grays with warm amber accent from camp lights
